what: Done::Changed { files: Vec<FileName> } and Journaled::files / lost (blaze-core lib.rs:570, journal.rs:329) allocate one Box<str> per changed name (FileName is Box<str>): fsevents.rs:863/997, iocp/usn.rs:312/402/435/455/489/533, watch.rs:291, sim/journal.rs. A restart catch-up of thousands of names is thousands of allocations. Exact edit: make both `files` fields the packed `journal::Names` (one bytes buffer plus u32 starts, already in journal.rs with push/push_joined) and give Names an `iter() -> impl Iterator<Item = &str>` and `sort_dedup()`; drivers push_joined into a kept Names instead of building FileNames; consumers blaze-vfs watch.rs and lib.rs, blaze-cargo serve/heads.rs iterate &str. Why: one or two allocations per batch instead of one per name, and names stay contiguous for the vfs lookup. Needs a differential test that the old Vec<FileName> and the new Names give the same sorted, deduped names over seeded batches.
